title: Controls and usability frustrations
summary: This topic centers on harder-to-use controls and technology, with examples spanning touchscreen operation, seat controls, parking, signaling, and one separate request for a favorable future deal.

positive.summary: The positive feedback is a request for an attractive deal on a future model rather than praise about vehicle usability.

mixed.summary: The mixed feedback says issues make the car harder to recommend to others.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mostly describe controls or features being harder to use or explain, but several fragments are too brief or context-limited to assign a clear sentiment confidently.

limitations: The cluster mixes related usability complaints with at least one unrelated pricing/deal comment, so it is not fully coherent.
